latestMedia.title: Imvo n'Imvano n'umunyepolitike atavuga rumwe na reta y'Uburundi, Agathon Rwasa
latestMedia.description: Muri iki kiganiro, umunyepolitike atavuga rumwe na reta y'Uburundi, Agathon Rwasa, yahoze arongoye umugambwe CNL aratubbwira ingene umugambwe wiwe wagiye ucikamwo ibice uhindura n'amazina, anishure abamunegura bavuga ko ashaka misi yose ko ari we aba mu kibanza c'imbere.

latestMedia.title: Menya ibintu birindwi ihuriro riyobowe na Kabila risaba kugira ngo rizitabire ibiganiro by'Abanye-Congo
latestMedia.description: Muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC), ihuriro riyobowe na Joseph Kabila Sovons le Congo, ryatangaje BBC Gahuzamiryango icyo risaba mbere yo kwemera ibiganiro by'igihugu bizayoborwa na President Felix Tshisekedi.

latestMedia.title: Imvo n'Imvano: BBC Gahuzamiryango yagiranye ikiganiro cihariye na Perezida w'Uburundi Évariste Ndayishimiye
latestMedia.description: Umukuru w'igihugu c'Uburundi Évariste Ndayishimiye yishuye ibibazo vyinshi abantu bibaza bivugwa mu Burundi, mu karere no ku mugabane wa Afrika.
latestMedia.imageAlt: Ifoto yakuwe muri videwo yerekana Perezida w'u Burundi Évariste Ndayishimiye yicaye ku ntebe y'imbaho y'imisego aganira n'umunyamakuru Cyriaque Muhawenayo (i buryo) wa BBC Gahuzamiryango, na we wicaye ku ntebe y'imbaho y'imisego.

latestMedia.title: Imvo n'Imvano ku gikombe cy'isi cy'uyu mwaka wa 2026 n'ibyayiranze
latestMedia.description: Ikiganiro Imvo n’Imvano kigaruka ku gikombe cy’isi cy’uyu mwaka wa 2026 cyegukanywe n’ikipe y’gihugu ya Espagne itsinze Argentine 1-0. Ni igikombe cyabereye mu bihugu 3 aribyo Mexique, Canada na Leta z’unze ubumwe z’Amerika.
